findings.recommendation: In POST /api/bookmarks, URL format validation returns 400 Bad Request with a detailed message ('Invalid URL format. URL must start with http:// or https://') rather than the generic string in SPEC Section 3.3. This provides helpful diagnostics and is covered by unit tests, but note the distinction if clients require exact error string matching.

A GET /api/bookmarks/<id> endpoint is implemented for single-bookmark retrieval. While not strictly mandated in Section 3 of SPEC.md, it is an idiomatic REST convention that enhances testability and API usability without conflicting with any requirement.

The client script implements normalizeUrl and safeHref to provide automatic 'https://' prefixing for bare domains while preventing XSS from javascript:, data:, or vbscript: URLs in href attributes. Maintain this defense-in-depth practice.

Database connections are created per-operation with check_same_thread=False and a 15.0s busy timeout, ensuring multi-threaded request handling without SQLite file-locking deadlocks as verified in test_persistence.py.

structured_output.summary: The MiniLinks application in examples/minilinks strictly complies with all requirements of SPEC.md. The backend cleanly implements the SQLite schema, CRUD operations, transaction management, and HTTP REST routing with standard library components only. The frontend delivers a responsive, accessible, and secure user interface with real-time debounced search, modal management, and XSS sanitization. The test harness provides 100% standard-library coverage across API endpoints, restart persistence, concurrency, directory traversal protection, and the 12-step deterministic smoke verification.
